value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim Preschool A-E for ages 3-5 - their site says fall registration opened Aug 11 at 7 a.m. YMCA of Oakville has preschool swim (3-5) and Goldfish Swim School has 3-4 yr group lessons at $32.50 per lesson, per their sites; I could not get into their pages today for days or times. I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
